survey.methodology: Active scene objects only; inactive pooled projectiles excluded. Root component categories are disjoint, unmarked building debris belongs to other. One census/second allocates query arrays; surveyMs measures its CPU cost. Delta is start-to-start; precedingFrameWork is previous LateUpdate-to-LateUpdate cumulative difference, approximate association only. Nested work stages cannot be added. No GPU/PhysX attribution. First observation omitted from slow-frame summary. Engine counters are optional engine published samples across recorded threads; -1 means unavailable or no new sample. Counter units and availability recorded; nested markers cannot be added. Publication lag means engine sample alignment is approximate. Top 32 frames over 33.33ms retained; indices refer to census array, -1 means none.
